scripts.build: bun run --filter '@xpkit-dev/core' build && bun run --filter '@xpkit-dev/react-native' build
scripts.test: bun run --filter '*' test && bun test scripts
scripts.release: bun run build && bun scripts/check-pack.ts --out .pack && bun scripts/publish-tarballs.ts
scripts.release:dry: bun run build && bun scripts/check-pack.ts --out .pack && bun scripts/publish-tarballs.ts --dry-run
